final_text: Average weekly point-of-sale spending in Saudi Arabia was SAR 13.95 bn in Q1 2025, up 7.3% from SAR 13.00 bn in Q1 2024. Average weekly transactions were 209.7 million (up 11.8%), and the average ticket was SAR 66.5 (down 4.0%). The largest movements were: Other increased by SAR 424 mn; Miscellaneous Goods and Services increased by SAR 151 mn; Clothing and Footwear increased by SAR 133 mn.
